name: Intelis
summary: Monitors competitor prices on Google Shopping and direct competitor sites and reprices your Shopify catalogue automatically with AI matching rules.
best_for: Shopify stores with hundreds to a few thousand variants that genuinely compete on price on Google Shopping and want competitor monitoring and repricing handled automatically
skip_if: your catalogue is small, you do not compete primarily on price, or your variant count sits just above a tier boundary and would push you to the next rung for a handful of SKUs
honest_knock:
The ladder counts variants, not products, and that is where stores get caught. A catalogue of forty garments in five sizes and three colours is six hundred variants, so a shop most people would call small lands on the $179 tier rather than the $49 one. Count your variants, not your line items, before you read the price.

The vendor's own numbers above Premium used to contradict each other, and that is worth knowing mainly because it has been fixed. On 21 August 2026 the Shopify listing said Business was $399 while intelis.ai/pricing said $499 with a $4,990 annual rate, and the homepage and the pricing page gave Enterprise as $749 and $849. Re-read on 8 September 2026, all three pages agree: Business $399 ($3,990 a year), Enterprise $749 ($7,490) for up to 10,000 SKUs. If you are working from a comparison written earlier this year, check its figures against the listing.

And automatic repricing is not a switch you leave alone. The matching is AI-driven across Google Shopping and competitor sites, and a mismatched listing quietly reprices the wrong product, while an unbounded rule set on a busy category is how a store races itself to the bottom. Set floor prices before you turn dynamic pricing on, and audit what the automatch decided in the first fortnight.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 8 September 2026 on apps.shopify.com/ecoprice-analytics, intelis.ai/pricing and the Intelis homepage; listing and pricing page re-read 1 October 2026, unchanged) Four tiers on the Shopify listing, priced by how many products or variants you track, each with a 14-day free trial. Basic $49 a month or $490 a year, a 17% saving: up to 100 products or variants, Google Shopping competitor monitoring, AI automatch for unlimited competitors, dynamic pricing, unlimited competitor URL tracking, reports, pricing history and chat support. Professional $179 a month or $1,790 a year: up to 1,000, adding variant tracking, sales analysis, live feed export, pricing strategy monitoring, an AI assistant and premium chat support. Premium $249 a month or $2,490 a year: up to 2,000, adding Shopify Markets support per market, Google Analytics integration and API access. Business $399 a month or $3,990 a year: up to 5,000, adding a custom labels feed for Google Merchant Center, MAP monitoring, a customised AI matching algorithm, pricing consultation, advanced analytics and A+ support. The vendor's own pages used to disagree with the listing above Premium -- on 21 August 2026 intelis.ai/pricing showed Business at $499 with a $4,990 annual rate and Enterprise at $849, while the homepage said $749. That is now resolved: on 8 September 2026 the pricing page and the homepage both show Business at $399 ($3,990 a year) and Enterprise at $749 ($7,490 a year) for up to 10,000 SKUs, matching the listing. The vendor's own pages count SKUs where the listing counts products or variants. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Developer Intelis; the app launched 6 July 2021 and carries a 4.9 rating from 97 reviews on 1 October 2026 (101 on 8 September).
